videos.title: Setup completo: Back-end Node.js com TypeScript, Fastify e Biome do zero
videos.description: This video demonstrates building a Node.js backend with TypeScript and Fastify, covering project setup with PNPM, TSX for execution, Biome for linting/formatting, and Zod for data validation. It also shows Fastify Swagger and Scalar API Reference for API documentation.

videos.title: Fastify Setup Tutorial with Typescript
videos.description: Learn how to build a modern, high-performance API with this Fastify and TypeScript setup tutorial. This guide covers everything from initial project initialization and dependency management to configuring TypeScript (`tsconfig.json`) for Node.js. You'll master setting up NPM…
